title: Jim Jarmusch: Why Do People Like His Movies?

commenti.body:
I’ve only ever seen Deadman but I was confidently blown away. I’m a pretty big western fan, I haven’t seen that many, but I thought that it was such a unique and excellent take on a western. One reason is they cover aspects of other movies that are glossed over. 

To me it was kind of like watching blue velvet for the first time. It felt like I went my whole life watching movies but deadman and blue velvet did the opposite of what I was expecting from seeing all these other movies.
